player_prompt.intro:
Ame nye Aɖa {player_id}. Ame le FifteenPuzzle ƒe eme ŋu.
Eme ƒe takpekpe nye be aɖa na ƒuƒu ƒe atike gbɔ kpɔkpɔ tso 1 va ɖo 15, eye aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ le kpɔkpɔ ƒe nuɖuɖu gbɔ.
Ne aɖa ƒe akpa aɖo eme ŋu, aɖa aƒe atike aɖe le aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ me (si wɔa kpe ɖe double underscore, abe __ ene) kple akpe 'up', 'down', 'left', alo 'right' ƒe ɖoɖo aɖewo:
- 'up': Ƒe atike si le aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ƒe dzi la ɖo aɖa ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi.
- 'down': Ƒe atike si le aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ƒe ta la ɖo aɖa ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ta.
- 'left': Ƒe atike si le aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ƒe nɔ la ɖo aɖa ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ nɔ.
- 'right': Ƒe atike si le aɖa si ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ƒe me la ɖo aɖa ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ me.
Ne aɖa ƒe akpa aɖo eme ŋu, aɖa aƒe akpe si aɖa ƒe ɖoɖo (abe, 'up', 'down', 'left', alo 'right') le square brackets me, abe [up] ene.
Eme ƒe atike ƒe ŋgɔŋlɔ ŋu wɔ aɖa ƒe nɔnɔ me. Xɔ aɖa ƒe nɔnɔ ƒe ŋu aɖa ƒe eme ƒe takpekpe.
